title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.328 - Added `onFailure` to `mcp_tool` hooks in the `Settings` type: with `"block"`, a hook whose call fails blocks the action it guards - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME`: set it in the `env` option to stop `resume` and `continue` from running a tool call that a hook deferred; settings can't set it - Added support for the policy plugin's `allowManagedModsOnly` option in host-supplied `managedSettings`; an admin's managed settings still win - Fixed the `agent` option: an inline definition in `agents` now wins over a user, project, plugin or built-in agent of the same name for model, prompt and hooks - Fixed the `agent` option: an agent from an agents directory now keeps its system prompt when `systemPrompt` is not set - Fixed the model saying background agents were still running after an SDK interrupt had stopped them - Changed subagents to wait for their own subagents by default when `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` is set - Changed a shell command rewritten by a `PermissionRequest` hook: the rewrite's own permission check now decides the sandbox, so a sandbox-excluded rewrite runs outside it; `canUseTool` is unchanged
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
